Each party's total liability arising out of this SOW is limited to [[liability cap, e.g. the fees paid under this SOW in the 12 months before the claim]]. These limits do not apply to [[exclusions, e.g. breach of confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct or payment obligations]].
clauses.Title: Limitation of Liability

clauses.Body: Either party may terminate this SOW for cause if the other party materially breaches it and does not cure the breach within [[cure period, e.g. 15 days]] of written notice. Either party may terminate for convenience with [[notice period, e.g. 30 days]] written notice. On termination for any reason, {{client}} pays for Services performed and expenses incurred up to the termination date, with any milestone in progress charged in proportion to the work completed, plus [[termination fee, or 'no further fees']]; {{seller}} delivers all work completed to date.
clauses.Title: Termination

clauses.Body: This SOW is governed by the laws of [[governing state or country]], without regard to its conflict-of-law rules. The parties will first try to resolve any dispute through good-faith negotiation between their executive sponsors for [[negotiation period, e.g. 30 days]]. A dispute not resolved that way will be decided by [[forum, e.g. the courts of a named county and state, or binding arbitration under named rules]].
clauses.Title: Governing Law & Dispute Resolution

clauses.Body: {{client}} remains responsible for the personal data in its systems; {{seller}} processes personal data only to perform the Services and on {{client}}'s documented instructions. {{seller}} will access only the data it needs, keep it confidential, protect it with appropriate technical and organisational measures, and notify {{client}} within [[breach notification period, e.g. 72 hours]] of becoming aware of a personal-data breach. For data migrations, data moves only through methods {{client}} approves, extracts and working copies are deleted within [[deletion period, e.g. 30 days]] of acceptance, and {{client}} confirms it has the right to migrate the data. Where the law requires it, the parties will sign a data processing agreement.
clauses.Title: Data Protection & Personal Information

clauses.Body: Neither party is liable for a delay or failure caused by events beyond its reasonable control, such as natural disasters, epidemics, war, government action, or failures of utilities, internet service or third-party platforms (including HubSpot outages). The affected party will notify the other promptly and resume as soon as possible, and the dates in this SOW move by the length of the delay. If the event lasts more than [[period, e.g. 30 days]], either party may end this SOW by written notice; fees for work performed to date remain payable.
clauses.Title: Force Majeure

clauses.Body: During this SOW and for [[non-solicitation period, e.g. 12 months]] after it ends, neither party will directly solicit for employment any employee or contractor of the other party who worked on the Services, without the other party's written consent. General job advertisements not aimed at those people are not a breach.
clauses.Title: Non-Solicitation

clauses.Body: This SOW, including its schedules, is the entire agreement between the parties about its subject matter and replaces all prior proposals, discussions and understandings. It can be changed only by a written Change Request or amendment signed by both parties. If documents conflict, they apply in this order: [[order of precedence, e.g. (1) the Master Services Agreement, (2) this SOW, (3) approved Change Requests]].
clauses.Title: Entire Agreement & Order of Precedence

clauses.Body: This SOW is issued under, and governed by, the Master Services Agreement between {{client}} and {{seller}} dated [[MSA date]]. Terms defined in that agreement have the same meaning in this SOW.
clauses.Title: Master Services Agreement

clauses.Body: This proposal is valid until {{valid_until}}. Once signed by both parties, this SOW takes effect on {{effective_date}}.
clauses.Title: Proposal Validity & Effective Date

client_responsibilities.Responsibility: Provide Super Admin (or equivalent) access to HubSpot and to every system being integrated.
Name one decision-maker who approves requirements, scope changes and acceptance.
Supply source-data exports, field definitions and sample records for any import or migration.
Make subject-matter experts available and return feedback and UAT results within 5 business days.
Keep the HubSpot subscription active at the tier this SOW assumes.

proposal.company_overview: SonaMation is a HubSpot Solutions Partner focused on revenue-operations architecture: CRM data models, sales and marketing automation, integrations, and the documentation that keeps them maintainable. Every engagement follows the same requirements-first method — requirements are written down and agreed before anything is built, and every deliverable is traced back to a requirement and signed off against written acceptance criteria.
proposal.confidentiality: This document and all Services are confidential information of the parties and may not be shared outside the client's organization without SonaMation's written consent.
proposal.expenses: SonaMation bears sole responsibility for all expenses incurred in performing the Services, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the client. Third-party software licenses and subscriptions are the client's responsibility unless listed as an included add-on.

proposal.payment_terms: As complete and final payment for Services completed, delivered and accepted, the client shall pay SonaMation the fees in the milestone schedule. Invoices are issued on milestone acceptance and are due net 30 days. All amounts are in U.S. Dollars.

team.Responsibilities: Accountable for the engagement's success; the final escalation point. Approves scope changes and signs off on acceptance with the client's sponsor.
Owns day-to-day delivery: plans the work, leads the implementation team, runs the status meetings, manages risks and reports progress to the client.
Runs kickoff and onboarding: collects access, schedules discovery and training sessions, and is the client's first point of contact during setup.

techniques.How It Is Applied: Every scope item cites the requirement it satisfies; nothing is built without one.
The live portal is audited first so changes are made against a known baseline.
Changes are built and tested in a sandbox before being promoted to production.
SonaMation tests internally first; the client then accepts against written criteria.

If a feature described in this SOW is not available on that tier, SonaMation will propose a revised design, or the client may change their subscription; either goes through the Change Request process and may affect the schedule and fees.

template.acceptance_process: Each milestone is complete when its deliverables meet the acceptance criteria in the scope table. The client has 5 business days after delivery to accept or to list specific deficiencies against those criteria; SonaMation will correct listed deficiencies and resubmit. A deliverable not rejected in writing within that window is deemed accepted.

addons.Includes: Portal setup, domains, tracking code, email settings

assumptions.Assumption: The client provides portal access (Super Admin or equivalent) within 5 business days of kickoff.
The client names one decision-maker who can approve requirements, scope changes and acceptance.
Client feedback and UAT results are returned within 5 business days of each request.
Quantities in the scope table are upper limits; anything beyond them goes through change control.

template.change_process: Anything not listed as In Scope in this document is out of scope, even if it is related. To add or change scope, either party submits a written Change Request describing the need. SonaMation replies within 3 business days with the impact on schedule and cost (priced from the add-on menu or the rate card). Work starts only after the client approves the Change Request in writing; approved changes become part of this SOW.

clauses.Body: On full payment of the fees for a deliverable, ownership of that deliverable (the configuration, documentation and materials created specifically for {{client}} under this SOW) transfers to {{client}}. {{seller}} keeps ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools, templates and know-how, including anything it uses across clients, and grants {{client}} a non-exclusive, perpetual licence to use them as part of the deliverables. Third-party software, including HubSpot, remains subject to its own licence terms.
clauses.Title: Intellectual Property & Ownership of Deliverables

clauses.Body: {{seller}} warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional manner consistent with generally accepted industry standards. For [[warranty period, e.g. 30 days]] after acceptance of each milestone, {{seller}} will correct at no additional charge any defect where a deliverable does not meet its acceptance criteria, provided the defect is reported in writing within that period and is not caused by changes made by {{client}} or third parties, or by changes to the HubSpot platform. Correction is {{client}}'s sole remedy for defective Services. No other warranties, express or implied, are given.
